meta.description: Qur'an division positions (Hafs 'an 'Asim, 6236 ayahs). Each range is inclusive: start ayah to end ayah.

pages.mushaf: Madani Mushaf (King Fahd Complex, Madinah), 15 lines per page

hizb.note: Each juz = 2 hizb; each hizb = 4 rub' al-hizb (quarters)

ruku.note: 558 rukus: the most widely used (Indo-Pak print / Quran.com) marking. Other prints differ (e.g. 540 or 556 rukus), so boundaries are not universal. Ruku 1 is Al-Fatiha; Ruku 2 begins at 2:1.
